title: CanonicalWorldExport
description: A world producer's generated world (world IR + Prolog KB) handed to a knowledge authority as a deterministic export envelope, ingested into the synthetic trust tier (KGP §7). Exact on the envelope; the `ir` payload is the producer's own versioned world-IR shape (permissive here).

predicateSchemaHash.description: SHA-256 over the producer's (name, arity) predicate pairs — the save-file drift-detection mechanism.

licenseNote.description: License class per KGP §7.1; typically PROPRIETARY. Ingested records land in the synthetic trust tier (KGP §7).
